pairs: Visio quam locutus est vir cum quo est Deus,
The vision that the man spoke. God is with him, and he,
et qui Deo secum morante confortatus,
being strengthened by God and abiding with him,
“I am the most foolish among men,
et sapientia hominum non est mecum.
and the wisdom of men is not with me.
and I have not known the knowledge of sanctity.
Who has ascended to heaven and also descended?
Who has grasped the wind in his hands?
quis continuit spiritum in manibus suis?
Who has tied the waters together,
quis colligavit aquas quasi in vestimento?
Who has raised all the limits of the earth?
and what is the name of his son,
Every word of God is fire-tested.
He is a bronze shield to those who hope in him.
Do not add anything to his words,
and be discovered to be a liar.
Two things I have asked of you;
do not deny them to me before I die.
vanitatem et verba mendacia longe fac a me;
Remove, far from me, vanity and lying words.
mendicitatem et divitias ne dederis mihi:
Give me neither begging, nor wealth.
Apportion to me only the necessities of my life,
ne forte satiatus illiciar ad negandum,
lest perhaps, being filled, I might be enticed into denial,
being compelled by destitution, I might steal,
and then perjure myself in the name of my God.
Ne accuses servum ad dominum suum,
Do not accuse a servant to his lord,
There is a generation which curses their father,
et quæ matri suæ non benedicit;
and which does not bless their mother.
There is a generation which seems pure to themselves,
et tamen non est lota a sordibus suis;
and yet they are not even washed from their filthiness.
There is a generation, whose eyes have been elevated,
et palpebræ ejus in alta surrectæ;
and their eyelids are lifted on high.
generatio quæ pro dentibus gladios habet,
There is a generation which has swords in place of teeth,
et commandit molaribus suis, ut comedat inopes de terra, et pauperes ex hominibus.
and which commands their molars to devour the indigent from the earth and the poor from among men.
et quartum quod numquam dicit: Sufficit.
Hell, and the mouth of the womb,
et terra quæ non satiatur aqua:
and a land that is not filled with water.
The eye of one who mocks his father
et qui despicit partum matris suæ,
and who despises the childbearing of his mother,
let the ravens of the torrent tear it out,
and let the sons of the eagles consume it.
Three things are difficult for me,
and about a fourth, I am nearly ignorant:
the way of an eagle in the sky,
the way of a serpent on a rock,
the way of a ship in the middle of the sea,
and the way of a man in adolescence.
Such is the way also of an adulterous woman,
By three things, the earth is moved,
and a fourth it is not able to sustain:
by a slave when he reigns,
per stultum, cum saturatus fuerit cibo;
by the foolish when he has been filled with food,
per odiosam mulierem, cum in matrimonio fuerit assumpta;
by a hateful woman when she has been taken in matrimony,
et per ancillam, cum fuerit hæres dominæ suæ.
and by a handmaid when she has been heir to her mistress.
Four things are least upon the earth,
and they are wiser than the wise:
populus infirmus, qui præparat in messe cibum sibi;
an infirm people who provide food for themselves at the harvest,
plebs invalida, qui collocat in petra cubile suum;
a sickened people who make their bed upon the rock.
et egreditur universa per turmas suas;
but they all depart by their troops.
The lizard supports itself on hands
and dwells in the buildings of kings.
There are three things that advance well,
and a fourth that marches happily on:
who fears nothing that he meets,
a rooster prepared at the loins,
Est qui stultus apparuit postquam elevatus est in sublime;
There is one who has appeared foolish, after he was lifted up on high;
he would have placed his hand over his mouth.
Qui autem fortiter premit ubera ad eliciendum lac exprimit butyrum;
But whoever strongly squeezes the udder to bring out the milk, presses out butter.
et qui vehementer emungit elicit sanguinem;
And whoever violently blows his nose, brings out blood.
et qui provocat iras producit discordias.
And whoever provokes wrath, brings forth discord.”
